name: (01) Dark Thaumaturgy (Path of Phobos) — 1 Basic — Induce Fear

system.description:
The infernalist stirs a mild paranoia in a victim's mind, the constant sense of being watched, menacing figures forever hovering just at the edge of sight.

Make a Static Mental Challenge against your subject's permanent Mental Traits; on a win they are affected for the rest of the scene. While afflicted they must make a Courage Virtue Test against two Traits to take any action that exposes them to their unseen stalkers, and they are down one Trait on all combat tests from the distraction of watching their own back. The Path of Phobos requires line of sight to its victim. Retest with Intimidation.
